rationale: Target 2 percentage points for all eight contrasts is adequate to resolve largest-class ordering at the large pilot dominance gaps. A 4x variance inflation addresses only 45 unequal-probability pilot observations; minimum 1000 per era provides diagnostic coverage, with an overall floor of 10000 transactions. Proportional allocation avoids trusting unstable pilot Neyman differences. It is not a guarantee of achieved precision. Final precision and dominance are evaluated without further sample enlargement.
rng: CPython random.Random MT19937 + Floyd SRSWOR; sorted ascending ordinals; strata H1 H2 H3 H4
scientific_rule: All six individual lower 95% dominance bounds >0; report simultaneous Bonferroni 95% family-wise bounds as additional evidence. If any primary contrast halfwidth exceeds 2 pp or a singleton drives an estimate beyond that scale, report inference unstable rather than resize.
